items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and sensitive.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, well-cushioned skin barrier, since the scan shows low moisture.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice for fair skin that looks easily reddened.

response.routine_note: Flushing, lasting redness, bumps and gritty eyes are better assessed by a dermatologist (and an eye professional for the grittiness) than by anything a shop can sell, so we skipped strong actives, which could aggravate sensitive-looking skin. Until then, cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the mineral sunscreen each morning.
